name: managed-docker-tracker-commands
goal: The normal task process preserves provider streams and an offline guest Tracker shim reaches the host-signed service for exactly its assigned item and run. Verify duplicate retries, denied scope, and task-owned cleanup in isolated Docker.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The managed Linux task routes provider prompt and output through a raw Docker attach. The signed relay is a separate sync fixture with no task shim. A synthetic provider must invoke tracker against its assigned run while preserving its existing stdin and stdout contract.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Extend the provider execution method states with an attached Linux task whose provider runs the real tracker executable. Exercise the same taskProcess entrypoint against local subprocess streams first and against the original Docker adapter on MB2.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
